why: We need one Windows-grounded record of what each original OLM AEX plug-in looks like immediately after it is added to a layer, before any parameter edits.

Mac ParamsSetup is the local source for current port defaults, but AE exact work benefits from a Windows witness for cold-start defaults, popup indices, hidden group state, built-in effect params, and property-order shape.
Capturing all fresh-instance defaults once prevents future ambiguity about whether a mismatch came from algorithm drift or simply starting from the wrong default state.

inputs.description: Use a simple opaque 1920x1080 source layer. The pixels are not the main point here; the manifest/property tree is.

instructions: For each case, create a fresh comp and a fresh source layer.
Add exactly one OLM effect to the selected layer.
Do not edit any OLM parameter after adding the effect.
Immediately record the full selected effect property tree, including hidden/group/no-value entries, built-in params, property_index, match_name, name, enabled/active state, and value where readable.
Save both before_effects_frame and the effect output PNG even though visual output is secondary for this request.

cases.reason: Capture cold-start defaults, especially Repeat/Bias/Legacy and the initial float/fixed slider values.
Capture the full default property tree for top-level controls, per-color blocks, replace-color controls, and grouped no-value entries.
Capture default front/back/noise block values and group layout before any edits.
Capture default thresholds, colors, render/interp/blur mode popup indices, and any built-in compositing params.
Capture all default ray lengths, merge/channel popups, color ramps, and the raw property ordering of the Windows AEX.
Capture outer/inner defaults, center point, repeat-border, ellipse block, and noise defaults on a fresh effect instance.
Capture v1 Use Key / Key Color / Tolerance defaults and the exact Windows-visible label path for the tolerance control.
Capture v2 key/gamma/version block defaults and popup indices immediately after effect creation.
Capture the simple single-slider default and any built-in AE effect params alongside it.

manifest_requirements: Record all selected effect property names, match_names, property_index, property_type, property_value_type, enabled/active state, and values where readable.
Record hidden/group/no-value properties too; do not omit them just because AE scripting cannot read a scalar value.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
Save both before_effects_frame and effect output PNG for every case.
Treat this as a fresh-instance default capture: no manual edits after the effect is added.
mac_follow_up: Use the returned manifest as the Windows source of truth for fresh-instance defaults and property ordering.
Diff the Windows defaults against notes/PARAMETER_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md and the extracted Mac param schema before assuming any default mismatch is algorithmic.
